title: Treat the clinical-data persistence layer and openEHR explicitly
requirements:
- Add a subsection to 3.6 on the persistence layer and what a country decides when choosing how clinical data are held
- Extend the open-standards condition to name a formalism for structured clinical information models (e.g. openEHR, ISO/TC 215 standards), citing supporting evidence
- Add openEHR archetypes/templates to the structure element in Figures 3.2 and 3.5
- Publish a standards architecture with roles and versions per exchange pattern
- Recommend openEHR archetypes/templates, with ISO 13606 as equivalent, as FHIR is recommended for services
- Require traceability and governed transformations between FHIR profiles and openEHR artefacts
- Replace 'FHIR-based store' in Figures 3.2 and 3.5 with wording consistent with the technology-neutral stance
- Align the Lifelong Health Record description with Annex D.1's acceptance of both FHIR servers and openEHR repositories
